note: Complete no-artifact diagnostics on three default repetitions of the same full real-source scan/map. Both policies already skip unused ICP normals and share map loading and its NN reference. Only the I/O loader changes: eligible little-endian binary PLY with only double XYZ fields uses a bounded bulk read. Both execute actual loading, cloud copies, native NN preparation/search, statistics, report assembly, transformed result construction and cleanup. A saved actual full-source ICP result is supplied at the native solver boundary after preparation. Live solver iterations, artifact/PLY output, tracing/hashing/ writes and CLI writes are excluded. The separately timed loading interval sequentially loads and releases the same four default inputs without the rest of the diagnostic. Both intervals have excluded parity and first-use pairs, one warm-up pair and five default alternating timed pairs; no observations removed. Measured coordinates are unchanged, with no generated geometry, perturbation or additional thinning. Repeated attempts are not independent drive frames or recorded SLAM telemetry. Warmed file pages; no cold-ingestion, RSS, full iterative ICP/SLAM or GPU performance claim.
